abilities.name: Gravity Suppression
abilities.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 1% of Welt's ATK to a single enemy.

abilities.name: Edge of the Void
abilities.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 0.72% of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and further deals DMG 4 extra times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to 0.72% of Welt's ATK to one random enemy. On hit, there is a 0.75% base chance to reduce the enemy's SPD by 10% for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Synthetic Black Hole
abilities.text:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 1.5% of Welt's ATK to all enemies. Has a 100% base chance to Imprison hit enemy targets for 1 turn.
While Imprisoned, enemy targets have their actions delayed by 0.12% and their SPD reduced by 10%. After using his Ultimate, inflicts the "Weightless" state on all enemies. When targets in "Weightless" state are attacked, their actions are delayed by 4%. This effect can trigger up to 8 time(s) per target per turn. "Weightless" lasts for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Time Distortion
abilities.text: Enemy targets in the "Weightless" state have their DEF reduced by 40% and their SPD reduced by 5%. When Welt attacks an enemy that is already Slowed, he additionally deals Imaginary Additional DMG equal to 1% of his ATK to the enemy.

abilities.name: Gravitational Imprisonment
abilities.text:
After using Welt's Technique, create a Special Dimension that lasts for 15 second(s). Enemies in this Special Dimension have their movement speed reduced by 50%. After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a 100% base chance to Imprison the enemies for 1 turn.
Imprisoned enemies have their actions delayed by 20% and SPD reduced by 10%. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.desc: When ally targets attack targets under the Weightless state, their DMG dealt increases by 10%. This effect stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 2 turn(s). At the start of the battle, Welt regenerates 30 Energy.

abilities.name: Judgment
abilities.desc: When Welt uses Basic ATK or Skill, additionally deals 1 extra instance of Additional DMG to the enemy target. The Additional DMG dealt when using Basic ATK is equal to 80% of Basic ATK DMG multiplier. The Additional DMG dealt when using Skill is equal to 120% of Skill DMG multiplier.

abilities.name: Punishment
abilities.desc: When Welt's Effect Hit Rate is greater than 40%, for every 10% that exceeds this value, increases ATK by 20%, up to a maximum increase of 80%. When using Ultimate, additionally restores 5 Energy.

abilities.name: Legacy of Honor
abilities.desc: After using a Skill or Ultimate to hit a target in the "Weightless" state, deals 1 additional instance of Imaginary Additional DMG equal to 40% of the Ultimate's DMG multiplier. This effect can only be triggered once per target per attack.

abilities.name: Conflux of Stars
abilities.desc: When his Talent is triggered, Welt regenerates 3 Energy.

abilities.name: Prayer of Peace
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1. up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Appellation of Justice
abilities.desc: Enemy targets in the "Weightless" state have their All-Type RES reduced by 30%.

abilities.name: Power of Kindness
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Prospect of Glory
abilities.desc: When using a Skill or Ultimate to hit an enemy target in the Slow state, increases CRIT Rate by 30% and CRIT DMG by 60%.
